title: Phase 86 Health, Public Health, Disability And Population Wellbeing Registry
scope: Inactive primary, preventive, community, acute, emergency, specialty, mental-health, substance-use, reproductive, maternal, child, elder, disability, medicines, supply-chain, surveillance, outbreak, environmental, occupational, climate-health, workforce, affordability, quality, safety, preparedness, recovery, equity, and population-wellbeing controls assigned one-to-one to the eight Phase 85 place-stability chains.
interpretation_boundary: Nominal capacity is not timely access; coverage is not affordable care; an encounter is not a health outcome; a surveillance signal is not a diagnosis; an emergency declaration is not readiness; service reopening is not population recovery.
activation_rule: No Phase 86 record can open until its Phase 85 predecessor contains verified housing delivery and occupancy, habitability and accessibility, durable tenure and affordability, stable exits from homelessness, displacement protection, completed retrofit evidence, climate and disaster housing capacity, voluntary relocation and enforceable return, reconstruction and neighborhood recovery, long-horizon place stability, independent review, and dated receipts. None does.
